 EXCLUSIVE: NCIS: Origins is pushing the boundaries of time and space by bringing together both Leroy Jethro Gibbs—played by Mark Harmon in a special present-day timeline and Austin Stowell, the series lead who exists on a past timeline. Watch our teaser above.
 In tonight’s episode titled “Shot Through the Heart,” past and present collide for Gibbs (Harmon) as he searches for answers about what happened to Lala (Mariel Molino) all those years ago. In 1993, an unexpected bond forms between Franks (Mike Franks) and Lala as the team races to expose a mole after FBI Agent Casey Bloom (Sean Harmon) is shot.

 David J. North, showrunner and executive producer of NCIS: Origins , teases how Gibbs is able to meet his younger self in the episode.
 “Gibbs was shot in the season premiere, and he hasn’t had time to tend to his injury properly. He’s been a little busy. But the effects of his injury are finally catching up to him, and the mind can play tricks on you when you’re injured. In the history of NCIS , we’ve seen Gibbs go into a dream-like state several times, and it’s fun to take a wild trip into his mind,” North shared.
 Mark Harmon as Leroy Jethro Gibbs and Mariel Molino as Cecilia “Lala” Dominguez 
 As exciting as seeing both versions of Gibbs see each other face-to-face, there’s also a warm moment that reunites Harmon’s Gibbs with Lala, as the mystery behind her never having been on NCIS continues to unfold.
 “It felt totally surreal. Very special. Mark loves this cast. And they love him. When I told them we were going to do this, everyone was really stoked. Mark, Austin, and Mariel are amazing in the scene. We can’t wait for the fans to see it,” shared North.
 In addition to the above surprises, Muse Watson will appear in the episode as Franks, as Deadline revealed last week. It makes sense that Gibbs and Franks, who is long dead, will be able to reconnect through this dreamy state.
 North teases what else viewers will see in “Shot Through The Heart.”
 “Let’s just say fans of Top Gun won’t be disappointed. Plus, Austin’s Gibbs and Lala aren’t the only blasts from the past visiting Mark. Also, Franks and Lala make a decision that will later change everyone’s lives forever. Oh, and Randy [Caleb Foote] meets his brunette doppelganger, which is a lot of fun. NCIS  fans, old and new, won’t want to miss this one,” he said.
